name: Powerbazinga TV

noteEn: The most-watched Spanish-language Elden Ring guide channel. Covers practical topics: rune farming, build tier lists, area secrets, 100% platinum. Clear language, no ego, no padding to extend videos.

Guía de platino al 100% paso a paso
highlightsEn: Elden Ring + Shadow of the Erdtree guides with full coverage
